pages.title: Deployment boundaries
pages.description: The project website, authenticated gateway and self-hosted services have different responsibilities.

sections.title: Keep the runtime self-hosted
paragraphs: Cloudflare serves this website. Rebekah's Nix-built OCI runtime hosts the agent, inference and evidence services on the operator's machine.
Follow the canonical deployment contract for image pins, per-service isolation, secret injection and container verification. Ephor remains an explicit opt-in integration.

name: Rebekah
tagline: A reproducible home for governed agentic work.
description: A self-hosted, Nix-built OCI runtime combining local inference, agent execution, engineering provenance and durable review evidence.
status: Executable bootstrap · not yet a production distribution

sections.title: One runtime, distinct responsibilities
paragraphs: OpenCode handles interactive agents; Ollama provides local inference; Sylvae runs portable skills; WeftMark keeps engineering provenance and review evidence. Nostoi provides audit-chain tooling.

Services run with separate identities and state directories. Loopback services are reached through an authenticated, allow-listed gateway; runtime secrets are injected rather than included in the image.

sections.title: Governance is an explicit integration
paragraphs: Ephor is opt-in. The public baseline image works without it; the separate governed image includes the fail-closed connector and oversight path.
Ephor was formerly KAGP, the Konsonans AI Governance Platform. Older documentation and integration names may use that name; they refer to the same project's earlier identity.

sections.title: Build, pin, verify
paragraphs: Follow the deployment contract to build with Nix, inject secrets at runtime, pin the image by digest or image ID, and verify it in a real container. Local service health is distinct from this website's health endpoint.
Cloudflare hosts this project website. The self-hosted OCI services and authenticated gateway remain on the operator's runtime host.
